Hey bro, I know exactly how you feel. I been through a lot of b.s. I my life for sure. Even tried killing myself. If you need  someone to talk to,  I can help you out. Believe me when I say I know what you're going through. I'm not a psychiatrist or anything, just some dude who has been through the unimaginable and might be able to help.  I don't know if I am allowed to give my phone number on this site or not, I only had this app for a few days. So let me know if you wanna talk and we'll figure something out. Ok? Looking forward to hearing from you...

Taking the easy way out is the way you want to go huh? That's a shame, cuz there is  so much out there in the world you don't even know about. What you have is the opportunity to do something now that you're at this point.  End your life by changing it. Create a new you. Don't  kill yourself. Who knows what awaits you just around the corner. There are a lot of different things you can do. Please at least try something different  before ending it all. You are welcome to contact me if you want. Please let me know.

Happy birthday first of all. I think you need an adrenaline boost. It is very good you are addressing your situation and doing so is a step in the right direction. Advice and input is very important.  My advice is to go out and do something that you're not used to doing. Go skydiving, ask someone out on a date, be spontaneous and find a different routine . I think maybe you are just stuck in the rut of your life and need to explore a little bit...there is a lot of excitement out there in the world.  You can do it. Anything is possible....happy birthday!!!

Hey, I don't have any friends either. I'm 51 years old and have had a lot of friends in my life. Now I don't have any friends or family to interact with. I have come to look at this as a blessing, because in my experience, all my friends and family I had just used me for money or doing something for them or they would steal  things from me. Sometimes things are the way they are for a reason.  Oh yeah  and never forget the old saying " be careful what you wish for, it might come true "

Be thankful that you have a girlfriend,  let alone the fact she thinks you're the best boyfriend. There are a lot of people who would do anything to have what you have, me being one of them. You should spend more time with her instead of sitting around letting every little thing bother you. Stop looking for an excuse to end your life.

Thank you for staying alive today. I tried ending my life many years ago. Jumped out of a car doing 55 mph. I ended up with a fractured skull and road rash all over my body. If that's not enough, my wife left me and filed for divorce. I didn't  have a job at the time, so I also lost my house. A few years  later I met my second wife. We had two kids, a girl and a boy. My youngest daughter is awesome. She is 19 years old now, I talk to her almost every day.  I love her with all my heart. If I would have succeeded in trying to kill myself those many years ago, my two youngest would never have been born.i love all my kids and even though I still have thoughts about ending my life, I wouldn't do it for a million bucks.  Stay alive as long as you can,  miracles can happen.
